protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: Store each task outside the repository in one collision-resistant project/task directory. Do not construct canonical paths by hand:

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: - The helper normalizes the absolute Git common directory and derives `<sanitized-repository-slug>--<first-12-sha256>` from that identity. All linked worktrees of one local repository resolve the same project ID; unrelated repositories with the same basename do not.

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: - `TASK_ID` must be 1-80 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, and must start and end with an alphanumeric character. Reject empty values, separators, traversal, control characters, and every value outside that format before path construction.

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: - `ANALYZE_CONTEXT_STATE_HOME` may override `~/.analyze-context`, but it must be a dedicated directory outside every worktree. The helper rejects task paths that escape the resolved state root.

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract
protected_invariants.text: - Branch and worktree names belong in the context file as metadata. They do not determine the task directory.

protected_invariants.heading: Storage Contract

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Do not fork versioned analysis files for the same task.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Never write canonical analysis state inside a branch, linked worktree, or main checkout.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Do not treat session end, compaction, branch removal, or worktree removal as completion or cleanup authority.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Use a distinct task ID for each concurrent task. Read only the exact task selected for the current work.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - One task has one writer at a time. Another session may read or resume only after the current writer stops or explicitly hands off ownership.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Treat legacy `.analyze-context-memory/` directories as read-only migration sources. They must remain gitignored and untracked until migrated.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Do not keep important findings only in chat history.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Mark a task complete only when every TODO checkbox is checked and `insights` contains the final summary.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Completed files may remain on disk. Cleanup is optional, later, and user-approved; hooks must never delete them.

protected_invariants.text: - Do not store secrets, credentials, or unrestricted sensitive source content in analysis state.

protected_invariants.heading: Trigger and Checkpoint Rule
protected_invariants.text: Do not invoke this skill for a quick one-file answer, ordinary code review, or short-lived lookup.

protected_invariants.text: - On `PreCompact` or `PreCompress`, remind the model to update context, todo, and insights before compaction. If the host event is advisory, do not treat it as the only checkpoint guarantee.

protected_invariants.text: - If a host lacks either event, continue with the skill rule; do not emulate it with noisy per-tool hooks.
